observations.text:
# Bicleaner data

Repository for data models, dictionaries and any dependency that is already generated and trained by Bicleaner developers and publicly available.

interpretation: Repository-level GPL-3.0 declaration is positive licensing evidence for the publisher repository. It does not identify per-resource source corpora or prove redistribution rights to every underlying training text. No illegality or definitive model-rights clearance is claimed.
archive_notice_finding: No standalone licence, notice, attribution or source-corpus inventory in the complete archive inventory; YAML contains no such fields. Unread payloads were not searched for embedded notices.
